_note: Oldest-end sweep batch 53: 26-31 March 2026. Model claude-opus-5, prompt v1.

mentions.claim_text: He says they are going to protect them in the spirit and in the natural, that he truly believes as they come together tonight they can change things, and that he spent most of the day praying.
mentions.quote: We're going to protect them in the spirit and in the natural
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: the standing frame that the gathering changes outcomes.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says people tell him they love the Lord and that he finds the whole thing interesting because of the things he has told them the Lord showed him through prayer concerning certain cryptos and the five pillars.
mentions.quote: concerning certain cryptos, five pillars
mentions.falsify_match: The five named assets performing as described. The original telling is in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: They do not.

mentions.claim_text: He speaks of the bleeding of their tax and the bleeding of things, says they may think nobody is watching but God is, and thanks God for all he has done in the first quarter of 2026.
mentions.quote: the bleeding of our tax, the bleeding of things
mentions.falsify_match: Documented waste of public money.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Nobody is named.

mentions.claim_text: He says it was very detailed and that he even told them what they were wearing, that now they say there are a thousand of them, and reads a breaking item that US officials and Wall Street analysts are reportedly preparing for a possibility.
mentions.quote: I even told you what they were wearing. And now they say there's a thousand
mentions.falsify_match: A prior telling with the clothing detail, and a news report of a thousand. Both halves are checkable and the first is in this corpus.
mentions.falsify_miss: The earlier telling lacks the detail he claims for it.

mentions.claim_text: He says they have prayer meetings but do not pray and intercessory prayer meetings where they hardly ever pray, and that the Lord said they must come up to a different level, because if they assemble for intercessory prayer they must pray.
mentions.quote: We have intercessory prayer meetings and we never hardly pray
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is a criticism aimed at the practice his own channel is built on.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says heaven and earth will collide now, that as of the first, on Passover, there will be an acceleration of things, that he was warned again and it is time for breakthrough, and repeats acceleration of things on Passover.
mentions.quote: as of the first on Passover, there'll be an acceleration of things
mentions.falsify_match: A marked escalation from 1 April 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: A quiet April. Acceleration has no threshold anywhere in the corpus, but the start date is specific.

mentions.claim_text: He says it will start during the shmita cycle of that 28 and 29 period, that it could be not this seven year cycle but the next, but that it will always be at the end of a seven year shmita cycle.
mentions.quote: it will always be at the end of a seven-year shmita cycle
mentions.falsify_match: The start of the tribulation at the close of a shmita cycle.
mentions.falsify_miss: It does not. He supplies the escape himself: it could be the next cycle instead, seven years further out.

mentions.claim_text: He says he thinks this is Canada, that this is the video from when the Lord gave them the word, asks which word it was and is told the 23rd, and is unsure whether it says so.
mentions.quote: This is the video that when the Lord gave us. 23rd
mentions.falsify_match: Another on-air replay, with the date pinned from the archive rather than from memory.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes beautiful olive oil springing forth and says he believes it represented a new outpouring and a new press, pressure on the church, and that out of the pressure and persecution came beautiful oil.
mentions.quote: out of the pressure, persecution, came beautiful
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the same structure as shaking-to-the-waking: pressure is the mechanism, so hardship confirms it.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he said it would be over social media and all this, that it was back in September and here they are in March, and that the Lord said to watch Carney, to watch this guy, and that he is a devil.
mentions.quote: The Lord said, Watch Carney. Watch this guy. He's a devil
mentions.falsify_match: Action by the named leader that he would read as confirming it.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. A named head of government called a devil, with no act attached and nothing that could disconfirm it.

mentions.claim_text: He says that as he was looking into it today and driving and doing what they had to do for Diana for the eBay and everything else, he was praying in the spirit and the Lord spoke to him and showed him something.
mentions.quote: as I was driving I was praying in the spirit and the Lord spoke
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: another account of the material arriving during ordinary errands.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that as they enter April 1st the birthing pains will accelerate and it will be about signs in the heavens and another layer of things about to start taking place, with meteors and lights coming into the atmosphere.
mentions.quote: enter into April 1st, the birthing pains will accelerate
mentions.falsify_match: Notable meteor activity or atmospheric phenomena from April 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: None beyond the ordinary. Meteors enter the atmosphere continuously, which makes the signs half hard to miss.

mentions.claim_text: He says he does not know but the banks' lights were off, that he saw strategic plans concerning this, and that the Lord asked what he thought they were going to do, come out like Rambo with AK-47s and go into places.
mentions.quote: the banks' lights were off. I saw strategic plans concerning this
mentions.falsify_match: A coordinated non-violent attack on banking infrastructure.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. The Rambo line rules out the obvious reading without supplying another.

mentions.claim_text: He says he believes the war is truly not over and is about to flip thousands of miles, that he believes the retaliation attack is within their own, and answers why it has not happened yet by saying that if they expose them.
mentions.quote: I believe the retaliation attack is within our own
mentions.falsify_match: A domestic attack in retaliation for a foreign action.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Within our own is the hidden-cells claim again, with no date.

mentions.claim_text: He says it may have a little sliver of red in the middle as he told them, that there was a heart and it was beating for America, but that a lot of it was black and grey on the outer edges with only a little red in the middle.
mentions.quote: there was a heart, and it was beating for America
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: a picture of the nation's spiritual state, and by his own colour key black means darkness.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays that when they go to the appointment and the doctor says they have this or that wrong, they will start to get a good report, and thanks God that all things are possible to those who believe and that they are a believing people.
mentions.quote: that they're going to start to get a good report
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable in practice: any large audience produces both good and bad reports.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He describes gathering them in as a mother hen would her chicks, asks whether he believes that could be in the tribulation and answers yes, asks whether it could be now and says he prays not, and says he sees in part and hears in part so he does not always know the timing.
mentions.quote: So the timing of it I don't always know
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the clearest admission of the limit: he does not claim to know when.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says he sees calendar months above things, that the Lord takes a paper calendar of the kind you tear the months off and fans it, and that he sees the month.
mentions.quote: he'll take the calendar and he'll fan it. And I'll see the month
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable, and it is the fourth distinct account of how dates arrive, after the camera lens, the zooming and the clock face.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He says that what is supposed to be wormwood is 2029, April the 13th of 2029, and that it will happen on a Friday, and says that if that is true then he is looking into 2029.
mentions.quote: wormwood is 2029 April the 13th of 2029 it will happen on a Friday
mentions.falsify_match: An impact or comparable event on 13 April 2029, which is the published close approach date of the asteroid Apophis and is indeed a Friday.
mentions.falsify_miss: Nothing happens. The date is taken from astronomy rather than seen, and he marks it as if that is true.

mentions.claim_text: He says their job right now is not to focus on all that but to focus on bringing in the lost, and that the Lord said he is going to shake the nations in the days ahead and will shake the nations on April 1st.
mentions.quote: I'm going to shake the nations on April 1st
mentions.falsify_match: A major global event on 1 April 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The day passes quietly. This narrows shake-the-nations-three-years from a three year span to a single day.

mentions.claim_text: He says they will be able to do space travel and these things, that this is what they are doing, and that he saw jet engines running off just a little bit of water, adding that it is fine if they cannot take it.
mentions.quote: I saw jet engines running off of just a little bit of water
mentions.falsify_match: A water-fuelled propulsion technology.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. He anticipates disbelief and offers the claim anyway.

mentions.claim_text: He says he found it interesting because the Lord said acceleration of things concerning April 1st, that this is Passover, that the birthing pains will now double, and that China says what he told them, that China was in the meeting.
mentions.quote: watch the birthing pains will now double
mentions.falsify_match: A doubling of the pace of events from April.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Double is a quantity word attached to something that was never measured.

mentions.claim_text: He prays over every place of celebration and place of worship in the next week from today, calling every plot and plan uncovered and foiled, and that there will be no successful mass shootings or bombings or anything.
mentions.quote: there will be no SUCCESSFUL MASS SHOOTINGS or bombings
mentions.falsify_match: A mass shooting or bombing at a place of worship or celebration in that week.
mentions.falsify_miss: None occurs, credited to the prayer. The word successful does the work: a foiled plot also counts.

mentions.claim_text: He asks the Father to have mercy, says he sees harvest time twice, and says the same thing about Rosh Hashanah and September the 11th, repeating 9/11.
mentions.quote: Same thing about Rosh Hashanah, September the 11th
mentions.falsify_match: Something on 11 September 2026.
mentions.falsify_miss: The date passes quietly.

mentions.claim_text: He says he is in the month, in the summer months, going from July, that he sees August and he sees September, and that it is very clear.
mentions.quote: I'm going from July. I see August. I see September. It's very clear
mentions.falsify_match: unfalsifiable: months seen with no content attached, arrived at by reading forward.
mentions.falsify_miss: n/a

mentions.claim_text: He prays over the nation concerning the 250 years but more about September the 11th, praying into that timeframe going into the fall and over strategic things, and mentions the barge he saw floating down the Mississippi River.
mentions.quote: Praying into September the 11th
mentions.falsify_match: An incident on 11 September 2026, or one involving Mississippi river traffic.
mentions.falsify_miss: Neither.

mentions.claim_text: He prays in tongues, then says they will hear a lot of prophetic voices saying all this good is coming and a lot of chatter about 2028, that it is false, and that the church needs to rise up.
mentions.quote: A lot of chatter about 2028 and all this. It's false
mentions.falsify_match: The optimistic 2028 forecasts failing.
mentions.falsify_miss: They land. A direct call against other prophetic voices, which is rare and can fail.

mentions.claim_text: He prays for the Senate and the House and against an impeachment attempt trying to cause civil war in the nation, and says that for 2028 he sees darkness, great darkness around 2028, a plan, and that it will take the church rising up in prayer and fasting.
mentions.quote: for 2028 I see darkness. It's great darkness. A plan
mentions.falsify_match: A crisis around the 2028 election.
mentions.falsify_miss: None. Darkness is undefined, and it sits directly against the optimistic 2028 chatter he calls false in the same session.
